scheme_name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
department: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Maharashtra's cashless health insurance scheme for economically weaker families, now converged with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.
benefits: Cashless treatment cover for a wide range of surgeries and therapies at network hospitals, up to the scheme's prescribed per-family limit.
eligibility: Holder of a yellow/orange/Antyodaya/Annapurna ration card, or covered categories under the converged scheme
application_steps: Approach the Arogyamitra desk at a network hospital
Get the case approved before/at admission for cashless treatment
